title: Independent audit of the upstream engine refresh and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 1abe9ce (upstream engine refresh, CHG-20261013-002) against ADR0012, ADR0009/0010/0011, D10/D11 and the RULE-02/03/04 guarantees. Upstream identity checked through the public GitHub API: 6de59de1 is TheCardGoat/tcg-engines main, signature verified, sole parent 53a79413, tree d3496c4b equal to the inert clone (51,113 blobs). Reviewed selection/importer changes, the 59-patch reconciliation (RULE-03 P003-P028 and RULE-04 P029-P053 rebased; new P054-P059), adapter/Lab revision constants, the test-only projection probe and upstream debug-move, log, turn-flow and ink-drop changes. All 91 earlier scenario oracles are unchanged apart from the inkDropCounters -> inkDrops rename; 29 new scenarios add the static-loss fix and native ink-drop/lifetime/aura/replacement/projection regressions. Requirement/backlog edits add evidence links only; 548 dispositions and task statuses unchanged. Verdict: refresh confirmed.

Independent runs RUN-20261013-047..057 all passed at fingerprint 4ba45cc4 with exact timing: timing-valid full verify:foundation (270 project checks = 246 Node + 24 Python, 406 upstream passes/1 inherited skip/1,362 expectations, 2 injection tests), importer reproduction, separate byte audit with GitHub blob-id cross-check of all 363 pinned files/licenses, official source bytes plus AST entropy guard, 20-case auditor rules probe (16 earlier cases plus the confirmed static Adventurous-loss fix), RULE-03 adapter probe, HMAC re-derivation, manual-move characterization, bundle scan, boundary probe and Chromium 6 web scenarios/2 workers. RUN-20261013-059 docs:check covers this record.

Host isolated CI RUN-20261013-058 passed its first ten stages (frozen install, doctor, full foundation, bootstrap/restricted databases, local/test migrations, eight identities, live database) and failed at pinned-chromium: the fresh image could not download Chrome for Testing (187 MiB) from storage.googleapis.com within Playwright's 30 s request timeout. An unrecorded manual check measured about 7 KB/s from that host and a GitHub API timeout, so the connection was degraded; no retry. No clock discontinuity over 726,495 ms; owned project/volume/network/image removed.

Follow-ups recorded, none blocking integration: (1) manual/debug moves, now including upstream manualSetInkDrops, are still accepted with player authority through the server adapter (RUN054); PLAY-01 must begin with server and Lab move allowlists. (2) P056 changes upstream setup from at-least-two to exactly-two players; consistent with the current two-player kernel and blueprint, but must be revisited when X01 multiplayer/teams is certified. (3) Upstream structured move-log changes are PLAY-02 privacy scope, not claimed here.

Appended a dated audit section to docs/validation/upstream-engine-review.md and dated notes to ADR0012, the refresh plan and the engine runbook; updated AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md refresh status, F-CI/F-ENGINE/F-RULE-CERTIFICATION descriptions and evidence, the FEATURES summary, the RULE-02 backlog evidence link and the handoff.

Director-authorized integration: publish codex/upstream-engine-review (1abe9ce) and claude/upstream-engine-audit, run hosted CI on the audit branch, and fast-forward main to the audit commit once it passes. Hosted results are recorded in a later change.
